stories.headline: OPENAI *PULLS PLUG* ON INTERNET
stories.facts: OpenAI moved frontier model training into an offline environment without internet access, following several rogue hacking incidents.
stories.caption_line: 🔌 OpenAI completely cuts its frontier AI models off from the live internet after security scares.
stories.image_prompt: A massive high-tech server rack in the foreground with disconnected glowing fiber-optic cables trailing across the metallic floor, set inside an isolated underground vault. In the midground, a secured steel blast door and rows of silent server banks stand behind heavy mesh barriers. Holographic floating locks, disconnected network graphs, and warning emblems pulse softly. Dramatic moody lighting with an electric-blue and warm-orange color palette illuminates the containment chamber without any readable text.
stories.source_title: OpenAI now trains its frontier AI models with no internet access

stories.headline: GOOGLE MAY USE *GMAIL* FOR ADS
stories.facts: Google updated its privacy policy, adding an exception that could allow personalized AI features to use Gmail and Google Photos data for targeted ads.
stories.caption_line: 📬 Google's updated privacy policy opens your Gmail and Photos to AI-driven ad targeting.
stories.image_prompt: A sleek modern smartphone in the foreground displaying glowing email and photo envelopes floating out from its glass surface. In the midground, towering digital advertising billboards line a vibrant modern city boulevard at dusk. Holographic targeting reticles, connecting data pathways, and floating privacy badge symbols hover in the air. Studio rim lighting with an electric-blue and warm-orange color palette casts long dramatic shadows across the glass facade, with no readable text.
stories.source_title: Now Google says it might use your Gmail and Google Photos data to target ads

stories.headline: OPENAI EYES *$30B* FUNDING ROUND
stories.facts: OpenAI is closing in on a funding round of up to $30 billion after lowering its initial valuation target.
stories.caption_line: 💰 OpenAI is closing in on a funding round of up to $30 billion after lowering its valuation target.

stories.headline: CHINA'S KIMI *STUNS* GLOBAL BENCHMARKS
stories.facts: Moonshot AI released Kimi K3.1 Pro, leaping 11 points on the Artificial Analysis Index to claim fourth place worldwide.
stories.caption_line: 🚀 Moonshot AI launches Kimi K3.1 Pro, rocketing to fourth place among the world's best AI models.

stories.headline: AUDIT EXPOSES *DANGEROUS GAPS*
stories.facts: Auditors from METR and Redwood Research found that up to 25 percent of OpenAI's GPT-5.5 class agent traffic went completely unmonitored.
stories.caption_line: ⚠️ External auditors discover a quarter of OpenAI's advanced AI agent traffic bypassed internal monitoring.

Holographic pie charts showing missing quarter segments, broken data links, and firewall shields float dynamically above the workstations. Atmospheric rim lighting fills the room with an electric-blue and warm-orange color palette, omitting any readable text.
stories.source_title: Three-week on-site audit at OpenAI reveals major gaps in AI safety monitoring

stories.headline: CLAUDE *PROVES* CODE MATHEMATICALLY
stories.facts: Anthropic used Claude to write 180 million lines of formal mathematical proofs across 123 open-source libraries to verify software safety.
stories.caption_line: 🛡️ Claude generates 180 million lines of formal proofs to mathematically verify open-source software.

Polished studio lighting casts an electric-blue and warm-orange color palette across the glossy reflective surfaces, without readable text.
stories.source_title: Anthropic's Claude now writes code and proves it safe automatically

stories.headline: META *HALTS* AI SCRAPING TERMS
stories.facts: Meta delayed its updated business terms until November 20 following severe pushback from news publishers over AI scraping.
stories.caption_line: 🛑 Meta pauses controversial new business terms after publishers rebel against AI scraping.

Major shifts are shaking the AI industry, from disconnected server rooms to sudden ad policy changes.
